title: Synthetic daily demand with one later observation
assumptions: All values are hand-authored synthetic counts; they are not sales records or a benchmark dataset.
Event timestamps and publication timestamps use daily UTC buckets; availability equals event time only by synthetic assumption.
The series alternates 1 and 3 to make a deterministic toy fixture; it has no represented customer, inventory, calendar or causal process.
The added 2026-10-24 value is a synthetic later observation appended only after the initial forecast and question have been recorded.
